notes: Body roof in 7 thatch courses with lifted lips and a ragged eave (horizontal bands as in ref_4); tower tiers with rolled, gently uneven eaves; door hood in 4 courses; ridge roll. Thatch fibre and colour are for the material pass.
Rosette relief and rakes on the carved gable; seven round rafter ends on the porch beam; plank roof; cart, barrels, basket, jar under the porch. Rafter knobs are small at this distance.
18 merlon stones of irregular height (0.25-0.65 m) round the parapet; window with sill facing north-east (ref_3).
